title: The side dock, Lock and Glide
thisBuild: A dock on the left edge of every page: Lock, Hold, a filter and resonance pair, Repeat and Hush. ⋯ at the bottom adds Rec, the beat light, Stutter or Echo, and ◀ folds it away.

Lock freezes the page: no scrolling, tabs, menus or sheets, and back does nothing. Pads, the Padiano and effects still play. It also pins the screen (Android asks first); turn that off from ⋯. Hold the lock for a second to unlock.

The dock's sliders: the left one is the cutoff, the right one the resonance. They spring back when you let go, or stay put if you tap SPRING to make it STAY. Tap MIX to aim them at the pad you last picked.
Glide on every Padiano: each note slides in from the last one. Set the time (up to 1 second), and Legato only to slide just when notes overlap. It saves with the pad.
From the last build: Hold keeps short sounds going, Hold Last, menus open when you lift, the Padiano squares, In key only, and empty pads that record.
